messages.Improve sentences or explore vocabulary: Improve sentences or explore vocabulary with AI, in English or Vietnamese.

privacy: The text and context you submit are sent to Google Gemini. Avoid sensitive information. AI suggestions may need review.
mode: What would you like to improve?
sentenceHelp: Get several clearer alternatives, with explanations and when to use each one.
keywordHelp: Learn a word or short phrase, its synonyms, antonyms and examples in context.
sentencePlaceholder: For example: I very like learning English.
languageHelp: Choose the same language as your input to polish it, or another language to translate it.
contextPlaceholder: For example: An email to a recruiter
cancelled: Request cancelled. Your text is still here.
nosynonyms: No suitable synonym was found for this meaning.
noantonyms: No meaningful opposite was found for this meaning.
required: Enter a sentence, word or short phrase first.
textLimit: Your text is too long for this mode. Use up to 2,000 characters for sentences or 100 for vocabulary.
contextLimit: Keep the audience or situation within 500 characters.
invalid: Check the selected mode, languages and tone, then try again.
signInError: Sign in to use Language Enhancer. If you are already signed in, refresh your session and try again.
blocked: This wording could not be processed. Try different text.
rateLimited: The AI request limit has been reached. Please wait before trying again; some limits take longer to reset.
invalidResponse: The AI returned an incomplete result. Please try again.
unavailable: Language Enhancer is temporarily unavailable. Your text has been kept; try again later.
timeout: The request took too long. Your text has been kept; try again in a moment.
wait: You can try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
